title: disabled field label stays perceivable
rule: Disabled field: control disabled; label (and helper/validation) stay enabled so AT can still perceive them. Settings Save MAY disable until requireds are complete only with visible reason + this perceivable label (dual-cite with GOV.UK don’t-disable on public/question).
pass_when: Disabled control still has a perceivable (not disabled-away) label and helper/validation. If Settings Save is disabled, the reason is visible and the label stays perceivable.
fail_when: Disabled control whose label/helper/validation cannot be perceived; or disabled Save with no visible reason.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
